annotations.title: Calculators · Land tax on a property (at its land value)

description:
**Annual land tax on this property if it were the owner's only taxable
land** — the same calculation as `/calculators/land-tax`, with the state
taken from the property and the land value set to its latest land valuation
(`land_value_source: land_valuation`).

Land tax is charged on everything an owner holds in the state combined, so
for an owner with other land this understates the bill: add the land values
together and use `/calculators/land-tax`. Priced as the calculator plus the
land values. Land valuations are held for NSW properties today; elsewhere,
and for a property with no valuation, the answer is `available: false`.

**Price: 16¢ per call.**

assessment_date.description: Any date in the land tax year (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today in Sydney.

foreign.description: A foreign or absentee owner — adds the state's surcharge.

principal_residence.description: The owner lives here. Always exempt; returns 0 with the reason.
